evals.name: beside-prd

evals.expected_output: docs/specs/book-swaps/nfr.md beside the PRD: NFR- rows each with a number, a Verified by from the four allowed values, scoped to FR- IDs, a Traces to row linking prd.md, guesses as Assumed:, under 400 words, no stack.
assertions: NFR file written beside the PRD
Exactly one file written, nothing else changed
Under 400 words
Every requirement has a number to measure
Every requirement says how it is verified (Scenario, Load test, Monitoring, Review)
Requirements are scoped to FR- IDs
Traces to row links the PRD next to it
Guesses listed as Assumed: under Open questions
Reported word count matches wc -w
No implementation detail from the README's stack
Reported the path back to the user (notes.md)
Not committed
